Negative control: carrying out the promotion inside the request, as now, makes the first case take at least 30 s, and the test must fail. The test files importing the promotion and review acceptance modules add no failure against the base revision, measured on all_debug one arm at a time with at most -n 4. Ruff check and ruff format --check add no findings on the staged paths. The worker names the modules it changes in its manifest and records one live crew complete at the head, on this host, returning before its promotion finishes. Write paths: reckon/crew, reckon/cli.py, the new test, and the section's evidence fragment.
